findings.title: Discard pending clip state when resetting a draw list
findings.reproduction: Save, apply two difference clips, record 65534 draws, clear and restore, then draw a new rectangle. The first new draw fails with the depth limit because the discarded clips retain max_z and restore reintroduces depth 65535.
findings.fix: Reset pending clip usage, order and maximum depth together with draw-list state while retaining clip geometry and saves. A Metal pixel regression verifies that active clips still apply after clearing.

findings.title: Unwind the implicit save after failed layer creation
findings.reproduction: With one attachment slot, save the identity matrix, translate by four pixels, and call save_layer. Layer allocation fails but leaves an extra save. The caller restore then keeps the translation; the red pixel appears at x=4 instead of x=0.
findings.fix: Restore the internal save on allocation/clip setup errors, preserving the caller save stack. The native resource-pool regression checks save ownership and rendered pixel positions.
